headline: NY Anti-Arson Amendment and Communicable Disease Notice Removed
bullets: Communicable Disease notice no longer required.
takeaway: NY Anti-Arson and Communicable Disease coverage changes.
risk_statement: Changes in required forms and coverage may affect compliance and claims.

items.why: NY Anti-Arson Amendment removed, requiring anti-arson application within 45 days.
Communicable Disease notice removed, replaced by AP 0853UF exclusion.
